text.p: Liverpool are to discipline striker Stan Collymore after he failed to turn up for a reserve team match.
Collymore was on the team sheet for Liverpool reserves in a match at Tranmere on Wednesday but did not play.

In a statement on Thursday, Liverpool manager Roy Evans said: "Stan Collymore was selected to play in the reserve team last night at Tranmere, but said at lunchtime he did not want to play in the reserves.
"He failed to report for the game that evening and the club will take the appropriate disciplinary action."
Evans would not elaborate on the disciplinary measures.
Collymore has struggled to hold a place in the English premiership side since the arrival in the summer of Czech international Patrik Berger.

He has had a number of disagreements with manager Roy Evans and looks increasingly unsettled at the club who paid a then British record fee of 8.5 million pounds sterling ($13.6 million) to buy him from Nottingham Forest in 1995.
